name: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
summary: Inside the Aerie Peak Aviary, flight assignments fall to Gryphon Master Talonaxe. Falstad Wildhammer sends you there after turning away someone who came for an old Explorers' League friend.

sections.title: Sent Away
sections.body: Falstad Wildhammer has little patience for a visitor sent by an old Explorers' League member. He does not know who that friend once flew with, and flight assignments belong to the gryphon master. You can find Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary. Falstad has real work for anyone who stays nearby.

sections.title: What Talonaxe Remembers
sections.body: Gryphon Master Talonaxe remembers sending a gryphon rider to help Brohann Caskbelly. Talonaxe has long cared for the Explorers' League, for Talonaxe's father helped the first excavation team to find Uldaman. The rider was Rhapsody Shindigger, whom Talonaxe thought the best at the time.

faq.q: Why does Falstad Wildhammer send you to Talonaxe?
faq.answer: Falstad Wildhammer does not know who the Explorers' League friend flew with. So he sends you to the gryphon master, who handles flight assignments.

faq.q: Where is Gryphon Master Talonaxe located?
faq.answer: Gryphon Master Talonaxe waits inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.
